title: Syntax Highlighting
description: How the highlighter uses Chroma to provide syntax highlighting with theme support.

steps.title: Available Themes
steps.description: Multiple Chroma themes are supported including Monokai, Dracula, GitHub, OneDark, Solarized, and Vim.

steps.title: Highlighter Structure
steps.description: The Highlighter uses a thread-safe cache to store previously highlighted lines, improving performance.

steps.title: Token Representation
steps.description: Each highlighted line contains tokens with the original text and a lipgloss Style for rendering.
